responsibility: Declares the generic SSA propagation engine and substitution/folding framework for tree SSA passes. It defines propagation result states, helpers for marking statements as simulatable, interfaces for safe const/copy propagation and value replacement, the abstract ssa_propagation_engine callback class used by concrete passes, and the substitute_and_fold_engine used to rewrite statements after propagation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the propagation framework interface, including ssa_prop_result, simulation markers, propagation helper prototypes, and the ssa_propagation_engine and substitute_and_fold_engine classes. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-propagate.cc, it specifies the API and abstract callback structure, not the engine implementation.
